prophecy.strength: Direct, principled, willing to speak up
prophecy.riskAndGrowth: Risk: Can seem harsh. Growth: Speak truth with patience and tact.

service.riskAndGrowth: Risk: Being taken for granted. Growth: Set boundaries and learn to say no.

teaching.riskAndGrowth: Risk: Frustration with slower learners. Growth: Practice patience.

exhortation.riskAndGrowth: Risk: Discouragement when others don't respond. Growth: Know when to support and when to step back.

giving.riskAndGrowth: Risk: Being manipulated. Growth: Give with discernment.

admin.riskAndGrowth: Risk: Becoming controlling. Growth: Listen, delegate, and invite input.

mercy.riskAndGrowth: Risk: Compassion fatigue. Growth: Set emotional boundaries.
